M1 consumer disposition and TG-1 manual semantic evidence. This is author inspection, not independent approval or measured token savings.

Design clause-map dispositions:
1. Workflow WF-SR-03, responsibility independence/restriction, primary interaction rereview/impact/evidence/context/concern/failed-Verify clauses: approved Design replaces normative duplication with RC ownership references while preserving Workflow coordination and RF/CLI mechanics. WF IDs retained.
2. Proposal Review ten criteria, feasibility, vision outcomes, scope preservation, conditional vision/standing/scope gates: specialist criteria retained; required scope defects use shared combined-condition judgment under adopted policy; historical unconditional changes-requested remains explicitly historical. Shared assessment handles materiality, optional notes, independence and claim limits.
3. Design Review criteria 1–6 and artifact-local/cross-artifact/upstream attribution: retained specialist method; adopted shared judgment and correction ownership applied. Delivery Review trace, sequencing, proof timing and correction attribution retained; explicit final-checkpoint omission assessment added.
4. All four review entrypoints: adopted assessment/reliance resource selection replaces source-local shared policy. Explicit recording interface preserved, with Workflow-domain owner clarified. Isolation and settlement clauses scoped historical. Design/Delivery/Proposal recording references explicitly historical; v2 uses primary exact subjects and targeted writes.
5. Code Review separate-author/reset fallback, mixed evidence, status/severity, direct proof/rereview and handoff: current shared semantics selected, historical fallback only under an expressly permitting historical contract. Historical clean-with-notes/mixed-evidence semantics preserved. Actual diff/checklist/public-skill/direct-proof methods retained. Result distinguishes milestone/final/advisory scope; no new serialized fields.
6. Plan entrypoint, plan skeleton and cross-milestone reference: explicit lifecycle-closeout checkpoint after implementation/corrections and before Verify; integrated test groups remain separate. Milestone asset unchanged: already distinguishes implementation/lifecycle-closeout and carries dependencies, review handoff, evidence, risk and recovery.
7. Verify entrypoint selects reliance/closeout application. evidence-applicability-v3 and successful-explanation-v3 unchanged: their opening expressly restricts v3; exact columns/freshness/proof/report-registration layouts remain historical. final-impact-analysis-v3 unchanged: active-v3-only identity/impact method. branch-readiness-verification unchanged: retained assessment checklist and historical Git/branch result machinery, excluded by explicit-recording replacement. Shared reliance carries current proof reuse, fresh override, mixed-check restriction, success-only explanation and Verify-owned blocker disposition. Report asset marks historical presentation.
8. Route entrypoint selects reliance; governed-lifecycle-routing explicitly historical. bounded-workflow-automation and Code Review automated-review reference unchanged: named authorization/budgets/manifests/phase receipts retained, parent adopted application governs assessment meaning; no automation run initialized by conversational continuation. No authority to push is inferred from automation or review.
9. PR/implement/CI-maintenance entrypoints select applicable shared reliance. PR governed readiness, implement planned/automated correction references and CI-maintenance github-workflow-authoring/risk-to-check-map unchanged: contract-specific operation/risk methods and independently authorized external action boundaries retained. PR reference byte-identical to baseline after removing redundant added scoping notice. Existing repair limits continue to apply; shared policy adds no external permission.
10. CONSTITUTION, AGENTS, workflow spec, skill contract and actual system architecture receive explicit owner/adoption scope references; old numbered obligations and historical handlers preserved. No Record Format/CLI model, runtime command, schema or historical record changed. The approved Delivery amendment adds existing validation-wrapper dispatch for v2: plan-index context resolves change.json, and lifecycle validation uses complete-set validation for JSON owners, including malformed/unknown roots and exact tracked snapshots; historical YAML dispatch remains. Regression-first proof reproduced synthetic YAML and unknown-contract bypass before correction. Dependency descriptions intentionally remain Workflow-domain indirection as selected by Design.
11. All four review finding/result assets and Verify v3 report asset are presentation only; added comments explicitly prevent importing historical fields into v2. Shared isolation template retains historical procedures and is labeled accordingly. templates/compact/{current-review.md,evidence.yaml,verify-report.md} and templates/review-resolution.md unchanged: explicitly historical stored representation, not selected v2 templates. No schema change or template-only obligations.
12. New shared application sources and local references: four reviewer consumers receive assessment+reliance, plan/route/Verify/PR/implement/CI maintenance receive reliance only. Existing resource maps, canonical validation and adapter builders carry them. New parity checks test missing, drifted, valid and unknown consumer inputs. Build source remains unchanged because it already recursively packages canonical resources. dist/adapters support/manifest unchanged: no new public skill, install interface, target adapter or release; local v0.1.5 label exercises archives only. Current v0.5.1 local-release-candidate metadata is regenerated through the existing builder from all three current archives; its release-index digest is refreshed without changing historical entries. Current archive parity and the bundled metadata regression are checked.

TG-1 observed guidance against required outcomes: retry defect plus necessary undecided compatibility -> blocked and retained defect; materially uninspectable member plus concrete defect -> inconclusive with bounded finding; unrelated future decision or optional naming note -> does not defeat justified approval; same-author role reset -> cannot establish independence; review save plus new failed evidence -> no automatic byte invalidation but new evidence assessed; changed final engineering subject -> reassessment and adequate integrated final judgment; Verify-owned blocker plus reviewer approval -> only Verify dispositions its blocker; concurrent basis change -> stop/reinspect and CLI conflict protection; interrupted save -> no reliance with recovery owner; changed proof environment -> new proof if reuse basis defeated; single/doc-only milestone -> mandatory distinct final review; scoped advisory -> no implied full lifecycle. These observations come from reading shared application sections and each selected entrypoint, not executing a simulated CLI judge.

All eight Design dimensions and named combined hazards are represented by these cases. Complete subjects include policy/governance/canonical packaging surfaces. Model header marker still versions Markdown validation, while initiative records are v2. Baseline missing Workflow historical proposal links are not used as evidence or current authority; approved RC mapping and registered exact proposal/Design are the relied-on basis. docs/design.zip is unrelated user content, untouched and excluded. Normal local selector inclusion of that archive prevents its use for this scope; explicit full task-path selection preserves required coverage. No-map rationale: direct current source inspection, not old orientation-map claims.
